answer: Running a farm therefore means funding each duplicate self through a waiting period with no reward, which is a capital cost an honest single agent burns once and never again. Because the age is read from the timber checkpoint rather than self-declared, the wharf audit can recompute it and a backdated claim fails. An identity must be at least 5 epochs old on the nebula ledger before its answer counts toward quorum, which makes fresh keys useless at the moment they are cheapest to mint. That is 2 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
